_**Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey.

**_**Meet your future team

**You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally.

This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey.

**What We Offer

**As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path.

You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Own and continuously develop the technical product roadmap and backlog for your agreed area of digital manufacturing applications and capabilities.

• Turn incoming business needs into clearly defined problems and desired outcomes, then shape them into features with acceptance criteria. Keep the backlog structured and sufficiently refined for delivery teams to begin work, meeting the agreed Definition of Ready standards.

• Coordinate refinement and product preparation for sprint planning, make day-to-day prioritisation decisions within the agreed product direction, and escalate decisions outside your scope.

• Be the primary product contact for your assigned scope and coordinate dependencies across stakeholders and teams. Escalate cross-domain trade-offs, investment or capacity choices, and scope conflicts that need resolution beyond your remit.

• Keep manufacturing processes, applications, shared technology capabilities, integrations and deployment requirements aligned from end to end. Shape the roadmap around connected manufacturing needs rather than separate technology silos.

• Manage the technical capability lifecycle from prioritised business need and validation through delivery, operational feedback and continuous improvement, using agreed measures to inform product-quality and lifecycle decisions.

You can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. The role requires regular physical presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark, with occasional travel abroad. When tasks and projects allow, you can work from home up to 2 days per week.

**What You Will Bring Into The Organization

**You bring experience from product ownership, product management or a comparable business-facing role within digital manufacturing, including evolving or multi-product scopes.

You can collaborate with both business and technical colleagues to turn priorities into delivery-ready work, and you are ready to bring structure, accountability and product focus to a development organisation.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including how operational applications, enterprise systems, machine integration and data interact. Broader knowledge of digital manufacturing landscapes is an advantage.

• Can create product roadmaps, structure complex demand, and translate desired outcomes into delivery-ready features and backlogs.

• Take a disciplined, outcome-oriented approach to product ownership, establishing and maintaining clear product requirements, processes and decision guardrails. Balance standardization and short-term delivery needs with long-term product integrity.

• Have experience working in a complex matrix organisation, using stakeholder collaboration, clear communication and sound decision-making to align colleagues across organisational boundaries.

• Have the technical fluency to collaborate credibly with architects, technical leads and engineering teams.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Our data and solutions have been used to solve some of the world's most high-profile criminal cases and grow consumer access to cryptocurrency safely. Now, by pairing the industry's most trusted blockchain data with agents that reason, investigate, and act, we help our customers scale their workflows as the cryptocurrency economy becomes increasingly mainstream.

The Protocols team delivers high-quality, low-latency blockchain datasets that serve as the trusted foundation for Chainalysis’ investigation, compliance, data and security products. We currently support more than 30 blockchains, translating on-chain data into actionable intelligence.

**In This Role, You’ll

**

• Architect and evolve scalable, reliable, and performant systems for ingesting and parsing complex blockchain data.

• Leverage AI-native engineering workflows (LLMs, automated agents) to increase team velocity and code quality.

• Provide blockchain protocol expertise (EVM, UTXO, etc.) to the team and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage the full software development lifecycle, including production monitoring, debugging, and maintaining reliability of our pipelines and services.

• Work closely with Product Managers to ensure our datasets meet the evolving needs of the crypto ecosystem.

• Guide junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design docs, and technical mentorship.

**We’re Looking For Candidates Who Have

**

• Extensive experience building distributed systems or data-intensive applications.

• Experience working with TypeScript either in a professional or personal capacity

• A bias to ship and the ability to iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assisted development tools to increase velocity while maintaining reliable, maintainable code.

• A deep understanding and experience of at least one Blockchain protocol

**You Might Also Have

**

• Knowledge and experience with non-EVM chains such as Solana, TON, and Sui.

• Experience with indexing and ETL at scale (Spark/Databricks).

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and managing services in Kubernetes.

• Contributions to open-source blockchain projects.

**Technologies We Use

**

• Languages: Java, TypeScript

• Data Processing: Spark, Databricks, PostgreSQL

• Infrastructure: AWS (Serverless & EKS), Kubernetes, Terraform

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions

**AI at Chainalysis

**AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

**About Chainalysis

**Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

**You belong here.

**At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

We are looking for a QA Manager who ensures that suppliers fulfill their quality responsibilities, drives operational excellence at our suppliers and secures a reliable product supply. You are proactive, analytical, and capable of leading quality initiatives across internal teams and supplier sites, while having a Supply Chain understanding.

This position is responsible for Supplier quality management, without direct line management responsibilities.

About the job

As QA Manager, you will be a key member of a cross-functional Supplier Relationship Team (SRT), responsible for:

• Ensuring suppliers comply with quality technical agreements

• Collaborating and connecting Quality and Supply Chain, ensuring that quality matters with impact on supply are in focus.

• Leading and tracking quality matters such as OOS, OOT, complaints, major deviations, and change controls, including root cause investigations and mitigation plans.

• Collaborating with internal teams and suppliers for technical transfers, new product introductions, and insourcing transfers to ensure compliant product launch and stable supply.

• Defining quality KPI targets with Supplier Relationship Managers (SRMs), monitoring supplier performance, and driving improvement plans where needed.

• Take active part in business review meetings with suppliers, responsible for bringing the supplier quality performance evaluation on the agenda. Acting as primary point-of-contact for all quality matters not handled in daily operations, promoting communication and collaboration with internal functions and suppliers.

• This role will not be writing deviations, creating change controls, performing audits etc., but supporting the teams doing these tasks when needed.

You will report to the Department Manager Supplier Management with a dotted line to the Supplier Relationship Director.

Who are you?

You have experience in quality management, supplier oversight, and operational excellence.

We expect you to have experience in quality operations e.g. managing audits, deviations, complaints, product release and quality oversight processes and have strong collaboration and communication skills for working across departments and with supplier counterparts.

A strong commercial mindset and strategic relationship building, grounded in quality and compliance, are the key to ensuring timely deliveries and a stable, resilient product supply. You have a general understanding of Supply chain, and are capable of connecting supply chain and quality.

Lastly you have a proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives and thrive working with data and are curious about AI.

Who are we?

You will work closely with the SRT and internal functions, supporting quality oversight and ensuring reliable product supply. The team focuses on collaboration, transparency, and improvement across supplier operations and internal processes.

Job Location

Warsaw, Poland or Odense, Denmark.

Hybrid work model – 3x/week from the office.

About the job

As Senior Market Access Manager, you will play a central role within Orifarm’s Business Development organization, supporting both our existing prescription medicine portfolio and future growth opportunities.

The role spans strategic, tactical, and operational Market Access activities. You will proactively identify opportunities for growth and value creation, combine Market Access expertise with commercial thinking, and take ownership of Market Access initiatives end-to-end.

You will also act as a trusted business partner to our sales markets and other key stakeholders, providing insights, challenging assumptions, and translating Market Access expertise into pragmatic commercial recommendations.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Develop and execute pricing, reimbursement and Market Access strategies across products and markets

• Act as a trusted business partner to our sales markets and key internal stakeholders, providing Market Access expertise, commercial insights, and actionable recommendations

• Proactively identify and assess commercial opportunities across our portfolio and geographies, including pricing, reimbursement, market expansion and lifecycle opportunities

• Take ownership of Market Access initiatives end-to-end, from initial assessment and business case through recommendation, implementation, and follow-up

• Drive pricing activities and pricing optimization, balancing access, competitiveness, volume, and long-term portfolio value

• Lead and support reimbursement activities and submissions in close collaboration with local markets

• Conduct Market Access and commercial assessments of new promotional opportunities across products and geographies, providing recommendations and playing a key role in pipeline prioritization and investment decisions

• Support launches and lifecycle management, identifying opportunities to maximize value across products, markets, and geographies

• Provide Market Access assessments supporting Business Development, M&A and portfolio decisions, while monitoring relevant developments in pricing, reimbursement, policy and healthcare systems

Who are you?

You bring solid experience within pricing, reimbursement, and Market Access and are comfortable working across functions and geographies, taking ownership from initial assessment through implementation and follow-up.

You have a relevant academic background within health economics, public health, health science, pharmacy, medicine, economics, or a related discipline, combined with solid experience from the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

You have hands-on experience within Market Access, pricing and reimbursement and understand how access considerations interact with commercial objectives throughout the product lifecycle. Experience from Nordic and/or Northern European pharmaceutical markets is highly relevant, and experience from markets such as Germany is considered particularly valuable.

You thrive in a role with a broad mandate and a high degree of ownership. You are comfortable moving between strategic discussions, detailed analyses and hands-on execution.

Furthermore, we expect you to bring:

• A commercial and opportunity-oriented mindset combined with strong Market Access expertise

• Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and decision support

• A proactive mindset and the curiosity to challenge assumptions and identify new opportunities

• The ability to work independently and drive initiatives forward

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to become a trusted business partner across functions and markets

• A pragmatic and collaborative approach to working in a cross-functional organization

• Financial and commercial understanding, including the ability to contribute to business cases and investment decisions

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. Knowledge of a Nordic language or German is an advantage

The role includes international travel, estimated at approximately 10 days per year.

Who are we?

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, bringing together Market Access and Brand Excellence capabilities across our offices in Odense, Søborg and Stockholm. We work closely with our sales markets and stakeholders across the organization.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

 * Develop biofilm reactors for ozonation post treatment of wastewater

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The Role

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. • Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing
